label: written from papers, not bitwise to WRF
source: NASA MERRA-2 GMI replay monthly means (not aerosol-optical-depth-assimilating MERRA-2 aerosol reanalysis)
licence: NASA published data-use terms: unmarked NASA material may be reproduced and distributed without further permission; acknowledge NASA; no implied endorsement
pressure: Pa; model top 1 Pa plus cumulative DELP, layer midpoint; mean of ten annual monthly means
concentration: ug m-3; mean over years of monthly mass mixing ratio [kg kg-1] times monthly AIRDENS [kg m-3] times 1e9
dust: NASA radius edges 0.1,1,1.8,3,6,10 um converted to diameter; overlap into CAM4 diameter edges 0.1,1,2.5,5,10 um assuming mass uniform in log diameter inside each source bin. Diameter >10 um is excluded rather than reassigned to smaller particles.
sea_salt: sum of all five NASA sea-salt bins into WRF bulk SEASALT2; source size distribution is not reconstructed
carbon: NASA organic fields already contain particulate organic matter; no additional 1.4 multiplier
sulfate: SO4 ion mass, without an ammonium-sulfate molecular-weight multiplier
chemical_inventory: Ten public WRF driver fields, rather than the eleven CESM-NCSU bulk components described by the paper. No separate nitrate, ammonium or secondary-organic-aerosol source variable is synthesized or folded into another field.
corrections: No CESM-specific bias fit is applied to NASA input. Existing public WRF activation-runtime multipliers remain in the inherited kernels.
